thread:
Ravi: Putting up a short draft for the internal announce for v2.14. Change window 14:00-15:00 PT. Need blast owner and rollback triggers.

Nina: I can send the blast. Paste the blurb and rollback rules and I'll trim.

Ravi: Draft blurb: "v2.14 rollout today 14:00-15:00 PT. Key: batching heuristics, per-route pinning, streaming KV fix. Canary -> staged rollout. Oncall: Ken, Nina. Post regressions in this thread + #support."

Ravi: Proposed rollback triggers: sustained 5xx >1.5% for 5m OR p99 latency >900ms for 10m OR token-cost +20% over baseline.

Ken: I'll own canary pin/watch. Plan: 10m quick smoke then 20m stability before traffic increases. If rollback needed run `/deploy rollback target=production to_version=v2.13 owner=@Ken reason="<short reason>"`.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: canary -> staging | version=v2.14 | scheduled=14:00 PT | cmd=`/deploy target=canary version=v2.14 wait=10m`

Nina: I'll send internal blast at 14:30 PT if canary health is green for first 20m. Final blast copy will be posted here when sent.

Ravi: Last call for edits before 13:45 PT. Using this thread as single source of truth during rollout.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started at 14:00 PT  id=cb-1798782100. Health checks in progress.

Ken: First 8m look good. Monitoring logs and traces.

Nina: Blast posted and pinned at 14:30 PT: "Rolling v2.14. See thread for details. Oncall Ken/Nina. Rollback triggers in thread."

Ravi: Thanks everyone. Will file release note with links after window.
